requirement.text: At Start Up, the on board equipment shall perform an automatic self-test.

classification.rationale: The requirement specifies startup self-tests for European Train Control System (ETCS) onboard equipment on a train, which is an embedded/railway control system rather than a web application, mobile app, or AI-driven system.

rounds.text_checked: At Start Up, the on board equipment shall perform an automatic self-test.

test_strategy.rationale: The requirement specifies a system state trigger ('At Start Up') under which the on-board equipment transitions into and executes an automatic self-test, making state_based testing applicable. Additionally, startup and self-test execution forms an operational scenario that interacts with other requirements (such as PURE-ERTMS-R8 which displays the test result), making use_case testing appropriate.

test_cases.title: Verify automatic self-test trigger on transition to Start Up state
test_cases.preconditions: On-board equipment is in Powered Off / No Power state.
steps: Apply power to the ERTMS on-board equipment.
Observe the equipment state transition from Powered Off to Start Up.
Monitor system diagnostic logs to verify self-test execution.
test_cases.expected_result: Upon transitioning to the Start Up state, the on-board equipment automatically initiates and executes the self-test routine without manual intervention.

test_cases.title: Operational startup sequence executing self-test and providing result to DMI
test_cases.preconditions: Train driver prepares to start up the locomotive; system powered off; DMI connected.
steps: Turn the power switch/desk key switch to ON to initiate the system startup sequence.
Observe the automated startup process on the on-board equipment.
Verify that the system automatically performs self-test routines during startup.
Verify that the outcome of the self-test is transmitted for display on the DMI.
test_cases.expected_result: The automated self-test runs during system startup, completes its diagnostic checks, and passes the result to the DMI display.

final_text: At Start Up, the on board equipment shall perform an automatic self-test.
